map.Naegele法则：预产期 = 末次月经 + 280天(40周)，推算孕期节点与: Naegele's rule: EDD = LMP + 280 days (40 wks); computes pregnancy milestones and visit schedule

map.提示：Naegele法则基于28天月经周期。周期不规律、哺乳期妊娠或忘记LMP者: Tip: Naegele's rule assumes a 28-day cycle. For irregular cycles, lactation or unknown LMP, correct EDD by first-trimester ultrasound (CRL). Only 5% deliver on the due date; delivery at 37-41 wks is normal.
map.📚 深度解析：由预产期反推末次月经（EDD→LMP）: 📚 In-Depth: Back-Calculating LMP from EDD (EDD to LMP)

map.早筛建档时由 EDD 回填 LMP 推算受孕窗口。: At booking, derive LMP from EDD to estimate the conception window.
map.EDD 2026-10-08、周期 28 天：LMP = EDD − 280 天: EDD 2026-10-08, cycle 28 days: LMP = EDD - 280 days = 2026-01-01, conception ~2026-01-15.
map.EDD 2026-10-15、周期 35 天：LMP = EDD − 280 −: EDD 2026-10-15, cycle 35 days: LMP = EDD - 280 - (35-28) = 2026-01-01, earlier LMP than a short cycle.
map.反推和正推结果为何要一致？: Why should back- and forward-calculation agree?
map.EDD→LMP 与 LMP→EDD 是互逆运算，都应回到同一受孕窗口；若超声孕周: EDD to LMP and LMP to EDD are inverse operations and should return the same conception window; if ultrasound GA differs from back-calculated LMP GA by >7 days, correct EDD by ultrasound.
map.周期长度怎么影响？: How does cycle length affect it?
map.周期每比 28 天多 1 天，EDD 后延 1 天、LMP 相应前移 1 天，保: Each day over 28 extends EDD by 1 day and moves LMP back 1 day, keeping total 280 + (cycle - 28) days.
